source_agency: Department of Environment and Natural Resources - Mines and Geosciences Bureau (DENR-MGB)

retrieval.spatial_filter: Exact Caloocan MultiPolygon intersection via ArcGIS returnIdsOnly query
retrieval.geometry_retrieval_format: ArcGIS PBF decoded locally to GeoJSON

checks: no material residual geometry outside the Caloocan MultiPolygon (1e-14 square-degree tolerance)
final extent contained by the Caloocan extent

terminology_note: VHF remains Very High Susceptibility to Flooding in source data. VHF to CRITICAL is only a proposed internal CIVENTRAL compatibility/display mapping and is not DENR-MGB terminology.
service_limitations: This ArcGIS service honors GeoJSON when f=geojson is supplied in the query string; supplying it only in the POST form returned native ArcGIS JSON.
A small polygon response verified GeoJSON output, but several large geometry responses returned HTTP 500 in GeoJSON and native JSON.

The exact Caloocan spatial filter was used to retrieve OBJECTIDs first; each selected feature was then requested individually using the service-advertised PBF format and decoded locally to GeoJSON without quantization, precision reduction, or simplification parameters.

Non-intersecting source MultiPolygon components were removed by bounding-box rejection before exact overlay to avoid processing distant national-scale geometry; no coordinates in potentially intersecting components were changed.
Source polygons extend beyond Caloocan and therefore required exact local clipping.
